The '''TIE podracer''' was a racing [[Podracer/Legends|pod]] that resembled a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. It had faster acceleration, higher top speed, greater durability, better maneuverability, more efficient cooling, and was easier to repair than any other known podracer except the [[Sith Infiltrator podracer]].
